name: Leh
source: IMD Leh Station Climatological Tables & NREL NSRDB / ASHRAE Fundamentals
notes: Primary target region for ThermoShelter AI. Characterized by severe sub-zero winter temperatures (frequently below -15°C), low relative humidity (20-45%), thin atmosphere with intense solar radiation (>900 W/m² GHI at noon), and large diurnal swings (15-20°C).

name: Kargil
source: IMD Records & ASHRAE Climatic Design Conditions
notes: High-altitude mountain valley climate with severe sub-zero winter temperatures, significant snowfall, and high heating demand for disaster relief and military shelters.

name: Srinagar
source: IMD Srinagar & NBC 2016 (National Building Code of India)
notes: Valley temperate climate with cold, humid winters, moderate snowfall, and mild-to-warm summers.

name: Delhi
source: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) ECBC / ISHRAE Weather Data
notes: Composite climate experiencing extreme cold waves in winter, intense dry heat in summer, and monsoon humidity in July-August.

name: Jaisalmer
source: MNRE Solar Resource Map & IMD Climatological Normals
notes: Thar Desert climate characterized by extreme daytime heat, high solar radiation, low precipitation, and high diurnal temperature swings.

name: Chennai
notes: Tropical coastal climate with high humidity year-round, narrow diurnal temperature ranges, and cooling/ventilation-dominated design requirements.

name: Mumbai
notes: Coastal climate with heavy monsoon rainfall, consistently high relative humidity, and predominant need for natural ventilation and solar shading.
